-- A first-order student client of a supplied constructive pigeonhole proof.
import builtin:std/hol/pigeonhole.ctea as P
import std/hol/finite@1 as Fin
mode constructive
theorem collision (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (xs : Fin.List A) (ys : Fin.List B) (n : Nat) :
  Fin.HasCard(xs, succ(n)) -> Fin.HasCard(ys, n) -> not (forall x y : A, f(x) = f(y) -> x = y) := by
  exact P.pigeonhole {A := A; B := B; f := f; xs := xs; ys := ys; n := n}

import std/hol/finite@1 as F

mode constructive

data Traffic
| red
| yellow
| green

-- Exercise 13.1
theorem ex13_1 :
  F.length(F.cons(red, F.cons(yellow, F.cons(green, F.nil)))) = 3 := by
  rewrite -> F.length_cons
  rewrite -> F.length_cons
  rewrite -> F.length_cons
  rewrite -> F.length_nil
  refl

-- Exercise 13.2
theorem ex13_2 :
  forall x : Traffic,
    F.Member(x, F.cons(red, F.cons(yellow, F.cons(green, F.nil)))) := by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | red =>
      apply F.member_cons.right
      left
      trivial
  | yellow =>
      apply F.member_cons.right
      right
      apply F.member_cons.right
      left
      trivial
  | green =>
      apply F.member_cons.right
      right
      apply F.member_cons.right
      right
      apply F.member_cons.right
      left
      trivial

-- Exercise 13.3
theorem ex13_3 :
  F.Nodup(F.cons(red, F.cons(yellow, F.cons(green, F.nil)))) := by
  apply F.nodup_cons.right
  split
  intro red_in_tail
  have red_cases : red = yellow \/ F.Member(red, F.cons(green, F.nil)) := by
    apply F.member_cons.left
    exact red_in_tail
  cases red_cases with
  | left red_yellow =>
      contradiction
  | right red_in_last =>
      have red_last_cases : red = green \/ F.Member(red, (F.nil : F.List Traffic)) := by
        apply F.member_cons.left
        exact red_in_last
      cases red_last_cases with
      | left red_green =>
          contradiction
      | right red_in_nil =>
          exact F.member_nil {A := Traffic; x := red} red_in_nil
  apply F.nodup_cons.right
  split
  intro yellow_in_tail
  have yellow_cases : yellow = green \/ F.Member(yellow, (F.nil : F.List Traffic)) := by
    apply F.member_cons.left
    exact yellow_in_tail
  cases yellow_cases with
  | left yellow_green =>
      contradiction
  | right yellow_in_nil =>
      exact F.member_nil {A := Traffic; x := yellow} yellow_in_nil
  apply F.nodup_cons.right
  split
  intro green_in_nil
  exact F.member_nil {A := Traffic; x := green} green_in_nil
  exact F.nodup_nil {A := Traffic}

-- Exercise 13.4
theorem ex13_4 :
  F.HasCard(
    F.cons(red, F.cons(yellow, F.cons(green, F.nil))),
    3
  ) := by
  apply F.has_card_intro
  exact ex13_3
  exact ex13_1
  exact ex13_2

-- Exercise 13.5
theorem ex13_5
  (A : Type) (xs : F.List A) (n : Nat) :
  F.HasCard(xs, n) ->
  F.Nodup(xs) /\
    (F.length(xs) = n /\ (forall x : A, F.Member(x, xs))) := by
  intro cardinality
  split
  exact F.has_card_nodup {A := A; xs := xs; n := n} cardinality
  split
  exact F.has_card_length {A := A; xs := xs; n := n} cardinality
  exact F.has_card_coverage {A := A; xs := xs; n := n} cardinality

-- Exercise 14.3

    A := Answer; B := Bit; f := encode_answer; xs := xs
  }

-- Exercise 14.4
theorem ex14_4
  (A : Type) (B : Type)
  (f : A -> B) (g : B -> A) (xs : F.List A) :
  (forall x : A, g(f(x)) = x) ->
  F.Nodup(xs) ->
  F.Nodup(F.map(f, xs)) := by
  exact F.nodup_map_injective {
    A := A; B := B; f := f; g := g; xs := xs
  }

-- Exercise 14.5

  (A : Type) (B : Type)
  (f : A -> B) (g : B -> A) (xs : F.List A) :
  (forall y : B, f(g(y)) = y) ->
  (forall x : A, F.Member(x, xs)) ->
  (forall y : B, F.Member(y, F.map(f, xs))) := by
  exact F.map_coverage_surjective {
    A := A; B := B; f := f; g := g; xs := xs
  }

-- Exercise 14.6

  (A : Type) (B : Type)
  (f : A -> B) (g : B -> A)
  (xs : F.List A) (n : Nat) :
  F.HasCard(xs, n) ->
  (forall x : A, g(f(x)) = x) ->
  (forall y : B, f(g(y)) = y) ->
  F.HasCard(F.map(f, xs), n) := by
  intro source_cardinality
  intro left_inverse
  intro right_inverse
  apply F.has_card_intro {
    A := B;
    xs := F.map(f, xs);
    n := n
  }
  exact ex14_4 {
    A := A; B := B; f := f; g := g; xs := xs
  } left_inverse (F.has_card_nodup {
    A := A; xs := xs; n := n
  } source_cardinality)
  rewrite -> F.map_length {A := A; B := B; f := f; xs := xs}
  exact F.has_card_length {A := A; xs := xs; n := n} source_cardinality
  exact ex14_5 {
    A := A; B := B; f := f; g := g; xs := xs
  } right_inverse (F.has_card_coverage {
    A := A; xs := xs; n := n
  } source_cardinality)

-- Exercise 14.7
theorem ex14_7 (xs : F.List Answer) (n : Nat) :
  F.HasCard(xs, n) -> F.HasCard(F.map(encode_answer, xs), n) := by
  intro source_cardinality
  apply ex14_6 {
    A := Answer;
    B := Bit;
    f := encode_answer;
    g := decode_answer;
    xs := xs;
    n := n
  }
  exact source_cardinality
  intro answer
  exact ex14_1 {answer := answer}
  intro bit
  exact ex14_2 {bit := bit}

-- Proofs, Checked -- Chapter 15: exercise solutions.
-- Spoilers! Try docs/book/hol-code/ch15-exercises.ctea first.
--
--   cargo run -p cetacea_cli -- docs/book/hol-code/ch15-solutions.ctea

import ../../../std/nat.ctea
import std/hol/finite@1 as F
import std/hol/cardinality@1 as F

mode constructive

-- Exercise 15.1
theorem ex15_1
  (A : Type) (a : A) (ys : F.List A) :
  F.Member(a, ys) ->
  exists zs : F.List A,
    F.length(ys) = succ(F.length(zs)) /\
    (forall x : A,
      (x = a -> False) ->
      F.Member(x, ys) ->
      F.Member(x, zs)) := by
  induction ys with
  | nil =>
      intro member_a
      exfalso
      exact F.member_nil {A := A; x := a} member_a
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro member_a
      have member_cases : a = h \/ F.Member(a, t) := by
        apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := a; h := h; t := t}).left
        exact member_a
      cases member_cases with
      | left a_h =>
          exists t
          split
          rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}
          refl
          intro x
          intro x_not_a
          intro member_x
          have x_cases : x = h \/ F.Member(x, t) := by
            apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).left
            exact member_x
          cases x_cases with
          | left x_h =>
              exfalso
              apply x_not_a
              rewrite -> a_h
              exact x_h
          | right x_in_t =>
              exact x_in_t
      | right a_in_t =>
          cases ih a_in_t with
          | intro zs removal =>
              exists F.cons(h, zs)
              split
              rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}
              rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := zs}
              rewrite -> removal.left
              refl
              intro x
              intro x_not_a
              intro member_x
              have x_cases : x = h \/ F.Member(x, t) := by
                apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).left
                exact member_x
              apply (F.member_cons {
                A := A; x := x; h := h; t := zs
              }).right
              cases x_cases with
              | left x_h =>
                  left
                  exact x_h
              | right x_in_t =>
                  right
                  exact removal.right x x_not_a x_in_t

-- Exercise 15.2
theorem ex15_2 (A : Type) (xs : F.List A) :
  forall ys : F.List A,
  F.Nodup(xs) ->
  (forall x : A, F.Member(x, xs) -> F.Member(x, ys)) ->
  le(F.length(xs), F.length(ys)) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro ys
      intro nodup_xs
      intro included
      rewrite -> F.length_nil {A := A}
      exact zero_le {n := F.length(ys)}
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro ys
      intro nodup_xs
      intro included
      have nodup_parts : (F.Member(h, t) -> False) /\ F.Nodup(t) := by
        apply (F.nodup_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}).left
        exact nodup_xs
      have h_in_xs : F.Member(h, F.cons(h, t)) := by
        apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := h; h := h; t := t}).right
        left
        refl
      have h_in_ys : F.Member(h, ys) := included h h_in_xs
      cases ex15_1 {A := A; a := h; ys := ys} h_in_ys with
      | intro zs removal =>
          have tail_included : forall x : A, F.Member(x, t) -> F.Member(x, zs) := by
            intro x
            intro x_in_t
            apply removal.right x
            intro x_h
            apply nodup_parts.left
            rewrite <- x_h
            exact x_in_t
            apply included x
            apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).right
            right
            exact x_in_t
          have tail_le : le(F.length(t), F.length(zs)) := by
            apply ih zs
            exact nodup_parts.right
            exact tail_included
          have lifted_tail_le : le(succ(F.length(t)), succ(F.length(zs))) := by
            exact le_succ_succ_rev {
              n := F.length(t); m := F.length(zs)
            } tail_le
          rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}
          rewrite -> removal.left
          exact lifted_tail_le

-- Exercise 15.3
theorem ex15_3
  (A : Type) (B : Type) (f : A -> B)
  (xs : F.List A) (y : B) :
  F.Member(y, F.map(f, xs)) ->
  exists x : A, F.Member(x, xs) /\ f(x) = y := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro member_y
      exfalso
      apply F.member_nil {A := B; x := y}
      rewrite <- F.map_nil {A := A; B := B; f := f}
      exact member_y
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro member_y
      have member_cases : y = f(h) \/ F.Member(y, F.map(f, t)) := by
        apply (F.member_cons {
          A := B; x := y; h := f(h); t := F.map(f, t)
        }).left
        rewrite <- F.map_cons {
          A := A; B := B; f := f; h := h; t := t
        }
        exact member_y
      cases member_cases with
      | left y_fh =>
          exists h
          split
          apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := h; h := h; t := t}).right
          left
          refl
          rewrite -> y_fh
          refl
      | right y_in_map_t =>
          cases ih y_in_map_t with
          | intro x witness =>
              exists x
              split
              apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).right
              right
              exact witness.left
              exact witness.right

-- Exercise 15.4
theorem ex15_4
  (A : Type) (B : Type) (f : A -> B) (xs : F.List A) :
  (forall x1 x2 : A, f(x1) = f(x2) -> x1 = x2) ->
  F.Nodup(xs) ->
  F.Nodup(F.map(f, xs)) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro injective
      intro nodup_xs
      rewrite -> F.map_nil {A := A; B := B; f := f}
      exact F.nodup_nil {A := B}
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro injective
      intro nodup_xs
      have nodup_parts : (F.Member(h, t) -> False) /\ F.Nodup(t) := by
        apply (F.nodup_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}).left
        exact nodup_xs
      rewrite -> F.map_cons {A := A; B := B; f := f; h := h; t := t}
      apply (F.nodup_cons {
        A := B; h := f(h); t := F.map(f, t)
      }).right
      split
      intro fh_in_tail
      have preimage : exists x : A, F.Member(x, t) /\ f(x) = f(h) := by
        exact ex15_3 {
          A := A; B := B; f := f; xs := t; y := f(h)
        } fh_in_tail
      cases preimage with
      | intro x witness =>
          apply nodup_parts.left
          have x_h : x = h := injective x h witness.right
          rewrite <- x_h
          exact witness.left
      apply ih injective
      exact nodup_parts.right

-- Exercise 15.5
theorem ex15_5 (n : Nat) : le(succ(n), n) -> False := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact succ_not_le_zero 0
  | succ k ih =>
      intro bad_order
      apply ih
      exact le_succ_succ {n := succ(k); m := k} bad_order

-- Exercise 15.6
theorem ex15_6
  (A : Type) (B : Type) (f : A -> B)
  (xs : F.List A) (ys : F.List B) (n : Nat) :
  F.HasCard(xs, succ(n)) ->
  F.HasCard(ys, n) ->
  (forall x1 x2 : A, f(x1) = f(x2) -> x1 = x2) ->
  False := by

import ../../../std/nat.ctea
import std/hol/finite@1 as F
import std/hol/cardinality@1 as F

mode constructive

-- Exercise 15.1
theorem ex15_1
  (A : Type) (a : A) (ys : F.List A) :
  F.Member(a, ys) ->
  exists zs : F.List A,
    F.length(ys) = succ(F.length(zs)) /\
    (forall x : A,
      (x = a -> False) ->
      F.Member(x, ys) ->
      F.Member(x, zs)) := by
  induction ys with
  | nil =>
      intro member_a
      exfalso
      exact F.member_nil {A := A; x := a} member_a
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro member_a
      have member_cases : a = h \/ F.Member(a, t) := by
        apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := a; h := h; t := t}).left
        exact member_a
      cases member_cases with
      | left a_h =>
          exists t
          split
          rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}
          refl
          intro x
          intro x_not_a
          intro member_x
          have x_cases : x = h \/ F.Member(x, t) := by
            apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).left
            exact member_x
          cases x_cases with
          | left x_h =>
              exfalso
              apply x_not_a
              rewrite -> a_h
              exact x_h
          | right x_in_t =>
              exact x_in_t
      | right a_in_t =>
          cases ih a_in_t with
          | intro zs removal =>
              exists F.cons(h, zs)
              split
              rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}
              rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := zs}
              rewrite -> removal.left
              refl
              intro x
              intro x_not_a
              intro member_x
              have x_cases : x = h \/ F.Member(x, t) := by
                apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).left
                exact member_x
              apply (F.member_cons {
                A := A; x := x; h := h; t := zs
              }).right
              cases x_cases with
              | left x_h =>
                  left
                  exact x_h
              | right x_in_t =>
                  right
                  exact removal.right x x_not_a x_in_t

-- Exercise 15.2
theorem ex15_2 (A : Type) (xs : F.List A) :
  forall ys : F.List A,
  F.Nodup(xs) ->
  (forall x : A, F.Member(x, xs) -> F.Member(x, ys)) ->
  le(F.length(xs), F.length(ys)) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro ys
      intro nodup_xs
      intro included
      rewrite -> F.length_nil {A := A}
      exact zero_le {n := F.length(ys)}
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro ys
      intro nodup_xs
      intro included
      have nodup_parts : (F.Member(h, t) -> False) /\ F.Nodup(t) := by
        apply (F.nodup_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}).left
        exact nodup_xs
      have h_in_xs : F.Member(h, F.cons(h, t)) := by
        apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := h; h := h; t := t}).right
        left
        refl
      have h_in_ys : F.Member(h, ys) := included h h_in_xs
      cases ex15_1 {A := A; a := h; ys := ys} h_in_ys with
      | intro zs removal =>
          have tail_included : forall x : A, F.Member(x, t) -> F.Member(x, zs) := by
            intro x
            intro x_in_t
            apply removal.right x
            intro x_h
            apply nodup_parts.left
            rewrite <- x_h
            exact x_in_t
            apply included x
            apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).right
            right
            exact x_in_t
          have tail_le : le(F.length(t), F.length(zs)) := by
            apply ih zs
            exact nodup_parts.right
            exact tail_included
          have lifted_tail_le : le(succ(F.length(t)), succ(F.length(zs))) := by
            exact le_succ_succ_rev {
              n := F.length(t); m := F.length(zs)
            } tail_le
          rewrite -> F.length_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}
          rewrite -> removal.left
          exact lifted_tail_le

-- Exercise 15.3
theorem ex15_3
  (A : Type) (B : Type) (f : A -> B)
  (xs : F.List A) (y : B) :
  F.Member(y, F.map(f, xs)) ->
  exists x : A, F.Member(x, xs) /\ f(x) = y := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro member_y
      exfalso
      apply F.member_nil {A := B; x := y}
      rewrite <- F.map_nil {A := A; B := B; f := f}
      exact member_y
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro member_y
      have member_cases : y = f(h) \/ F.Member(y, F.map(f, t)) := by
        apply (F.member_cons {
          A := B; x := y; h := f(h); t := F.map(f, t)
        }).left
        rewrite <- F.map_cons {
          A := A; B := B; f := f; h := h; t := t
        }
        exact member_y
      cases member_cases with
      | left y_fh =>
          exists h
          split
          apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := h; h := h; t := t}).right
          left
          refl
          rewrite -> y_fh
          refl
      | right y_in_map_t =>
          cases ih y_in_map_t with
          | intro x witness =>
              exists x
              split
              apply (F.member_cons {A := A; x := x; h := h; t := t}).right
              right
              exact witness.left
              exact witness.right

-- Exercise 15.4
theorem ex15_4
  (A : Type) (B : Type) (f : A -> B) (xs : F.List A) :
  (forall x1 x2 : A, f(x1) = f(x2) -> x1 = x2) ->
  F.Nodup(xs) ->
  F.Nodup(F.map(f, xs)) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro injective
      intro nodup_xs
      rewrite -> F.map_nil {A := A; B := B; f := f}
      exact F.nodup_nil {A := B}
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro injective
      intro nodup_xs
      have nodup_parts : (F.Member(h, t) -> False) /\ F.Nodup(t) := by
        apply (F.nodup_cons {A := A; h := h; t := t}).left
        exact nodup_xs
      rewrite -> F.map_cons {A := A; B := B; f := f; h := h; t := t}
      apply (F.nodup_cons {
        A := B; h := f(h); t := F.map(f, t)
      }).right
      split
      intro fh_in_tail
      have preimage : exists x : A, F.Member(x, t) /\ f(x) = f(h) := by
        exact ex15_3 {
          A := A; B := B; f := f; xs := t; y := f(h)
        } fh_in_tail
      cases preimage with
      | intro x witness =>
          apply nodup_parts.left
          have x_h : x = h := injective x h witness.right
          rewrite <- x_h
          exact witness.left
      apply ih injective
      exact nodup_parts.right

-- Exercise 15.5
theorem ex15_5 (n : Nat) : le(succ(n), n) -> False := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact succ_not_le_zero 0
  | succ k ih =>
      intro bad_order
      apply ih
      exact le_succ_succ {n := succ(k); m := k} bad_order

-- Exercise 15.6
theorem ex15_6
  (A : Type) (B : Type) (f : A -> B)
  (xs : F.List A) (ys : F.List B) (n : Nat) :
  F.HasCard(xs, succ(n)) ->
  F.HasCard(ys, n) ->
  (forall x1 x2 : A, f(x1) = f(x2) -> x1 = x2) ->
  False := by
  intro source_cardinality
  intro target_cardinality
  intro injective
  have mapped_nodup : F.Nodup(F.map(f, xs)) := by
    apply ex15_4 {A := A; B := B; f := f; xs := xs}
    exact injective
    exact F.has_card_nodup {
      A := A; xs := xs; n := succ(n)
    } source_cardinality
  have mapped_in_target : forall y : B, F.Member(y, F.map(f, xs)) -> F.Member(y, ys) := by
    intro y
    intro y_in_map
    exact F.has_card_coverage {
      A := B; xs := ys; n := n
    } target_cardinality y
  have bad_order : le(F.length(F.map(f, xs)), F.length(ys)) := by
    apply ex15_2 {A := B; xs := F.map(f, xs)} ys
    exact mapped_nodup
    exact mapped_in_target
  apply ex15_5 n
  rewrite <- F.has_card_length {
    A := A; xs := xs; n := succ(n)
  } source_cardinality
  rewrite <- F.has_card_length {
    A := B; xs := ys; n := n
  } target_cardinality
  rewrite <- F.map_length {A := A; B := B; f := f; xs := xs}
  exact bad_order

-- Chapter 18: explicit directed paths.
import std/hol/graph@1 as G

mode constructive

-- Staying at a vertex requires no edge.
theorem ex18_1 (A : Type) (E : A -> A -> Prop) (a : A) :
  G.ValidPath(E, G.nil, a, a) := by
  apply (G.path_nil {A := A; E := E; a := a; b := a}).right
  refl

-- Prepend one edge to an already checked tail path.
theorem ex18_2 (A : Type) (E : A -> A -> Prop) (t : G.List A) (a h b : A) :
  E(a, h) -> G.ValidPath(E, t, h, b) -> G.ValidPath(E, G.cons(h, t), a, b) := by
  intro edge
  intro tail
  apply (G.path_cons {A := A; E := E; h := h; t := t; a := a; b := b}).right
  split
  exact edge
  exact tail

-- Removing the first visited vertex changes the start of the remaining path.
theorem ex18_3 (A : Type) (E : A -> A -> Prop) (t : G.List A) (a h b : A) :
  G.ValidPath(E, G.cons(h, t), a, b) -> G.ValidPath(E, t, h, b) := by
  intro path
  have parts : E(a, h) /\ G.ValidPath(E, t, h, b) := (G.path_cons {A := A; E := E; h := h; t := t; a := a; b := b}).left path
  exact parts.right

-- Join two paths at a common endpoint. Keep endpoints general during induction.
theorem ex18_4 (A : Type) (E : A -> A -> Prop) (xs ys : G.List A) :
  forall a b c : A,
  G.ValidPath(E, xs, a, b) -> G.ValidPath(E, ys, b, c) ->
  G.ValidPath(E, G.append(xs, ys), a, c) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro a
      intro b
      intro c
      intro first
      intro second
      have same : b = a := (G.path_nil {A := A; E := E; a := a; b := b}).left first
      rewrite -> G.append_nil_left
      rewrite <- same
      exact second
  | cons h t ih =>
      intro a
      intro b
      intro c
      intro first
      intro second
      have parts : E(a, h) /\ G.ValidPath(E, t, h, b) := (G.path_cons {A := A; E := E; h := h; t := t; a := a; b := b}).left first
      rewrite -> G.append_cons
      apply (G.path_cons {A := A; E := E; h := h; t := G.append(t, ys); a := a; b := c}).right
      split
      exact parts.left
      exact ih h b c parts.right second

-- Chapter 19: double counting and the handshake identity.
import std/hol/matrix@1 as M
import std/hol/cardinality@1 as C
import builtin:std/hol/double_counting.ctea as D
import builtin:std/hol/weighted_sums.ctea as W
import builtin:std/hol/handshake.ctea as H
import builtin:std/hol/sums.ctea as S
mode constructive

-- Compute the sum of a row with no columns.
theorem ex19_1 (A B : Type) (w : A -> B -> Nat) (a : A) :
  M.row_sum(w, a, M.nil) = 0 := by
  exact M.row_sum_nil {A := A; B := B; w := w; a := a}

-- Induct over the columns: a table with no rows has total zero.
theorem ex19_2 (A B : Type) (w : A -> B -> Nat) (ys : M.List B) :
  M.columns_total(w, M.nil, ys) = 0 := by
  induction ys with
  | nil =>
      exact M.columns_total_nil {A := A; B := B; w := w; xs := M.nil}
  | cons b tail ih =>
      rewrite -> M.columns_total_cons
      rewrite -> M.column_sum_nil
      rewrite -> ih
      simp
      refl

theorem ex19_3 (A B : Type) (w : A -> B -> Nat) (a : A) (xs : M.List A) (ys : M.List B) :
  M.columns_total(w, M.cons(a, xs), ys) = add(M.row_sum(w, a, ys), M.columns_total(w, xs, ys)) := by
  induction ys with
  | nil =>
      rewrite -> M.columns_total_nil
      rewrite -> M.row_sum_nil
      rewrite -> M.columns_total_nil
      simp
      refl
  | cons b tail ih =>
      rewrite -> M.columns_total_cons
      rewrite -> M.column_sum_cons
      rewrite -> ih
      rewrite -> M.row_sum_cons
      rewrite -> M.columns_total_cons
      exact W.add_interchange

theorem ex19_4 (Edge Vertex : Type) (incidence : Edge -> Vertex -> Nat)
  (degree : Vertex -> Nat) (edges : M.List Edge) (vertices : M.List Vertex) :
  (forall e : Edge, C.Member(e, edges) -> M.row_sum(incidence, e, vertices) = 2) ->
  (forall v : Vertex, C.Member(v, vertices) -> degree(v) = M.column_sum(incidence, edges, v)) ->
  S.sum(C.map(degree, vertices)) = mul(C.length(edges), 2) := by
  intro two_ends
  intro degrees
  rewrite -> H.columns_as_degrees {A := Edge; B := Vertex; w := incidence; degree := degree; xs := edges; ys := vertices} degrees
  rewrite <- D.double_counting
  exact H.rows_constant {A := Edge; B := Vertex; w := incidence; xs := edges; ys := vertices; k := 2} two_ends

-- Chapter 20: divisibility and modular arithmetic over natural numbers.
import builtin:std/modular.ctea as M
mode constructive

-- A divisibility proof supplies the multiplier.
theorem ex20_1 : M.Divides(4, 20) := by
  unfold M.Divides
  exists 5
  refl

-- A common divisor is preserved by this linear combination.
theorem ex20_2 (d a b : Nat) :
  M.Divides(d, a) -> M.Divides(d, b) -> M.Divides(d, add(a, mul(b, 3))) := by
  intro da
  intro db
  apply M.divides_add {d := d; a := a; b := mul(b, 3)}
  exact da
  exact M.divides_mul {d := d; a := b; k := 3} db

-- Congruent inputs give congruent values of x*x + 1.
theorem ex20_3 (m x y : Nat) :
  M.ModEq(m, x, y) -> M.ModEq(m, add(mul(x, x), 1), add(mul(y, y), 1)) := by
  intro same
  apply M.modeq_add {m := m; x := mul(x, x); y := mul(y, y); u := 1; v := 1}
  exact M.modeq_mul {m := m; x := x; y := y; u := x; v := y} same same
  exact M.modeq_refl {m := m; x := 1}

-- With modulus zero, the two padded values are just the original values.
theorem ex20_4 (x y : Nat) : M.ModEq(0, x, y) -> x = y := by
  intro congruent
  simp at congruent
  cases congruent with
  | intro a remaining =>
      cases remaining with
      | intro b equal =>
          exact equal

-- Chapter 21: recurrence equations and induction.
import builtin:std/hol/recurrences.ctea as R
import builtin:std/nat.ctea as N
mode constructive

-- Specialize a general closed form at four ticks.
theorem ex21_1 (f : Nat -> Nat) :
  f(0) = 2 ->
  (forall n : Nat, f(succ(n)) = add(3, f(n))) -> f(4) = 14 := by
  intro initial
  intro step
  have all_ticks : forall n : Nat, f(n) = add(2, mul(n, 3)) := by
    apply R.constant_step_closed {f := f; a := 2; d := 3}
    exact initial
    exact step
  exact all_ticks 4

theorem ex21_2 (a d n : Nat) :
  add(a, mul(succ(n), d)) = add(d, add(a, mul(n, d))) := by
  rewrite -> N.mul_succ_left
  rewrite <- N.add_assoc {n := a; m := d; k := mul(n, d)}
  rewrite -> N.add_comm {n := a; m := d}
  rewrite -> N.add_assoc
  refl

theorem ex21_3 (f : Nat -> Nat) (a d : Nat) :
  f(0) = a ->
  (forall n : Nat, f(succ(n)) = add(d, f(n))) ->
  forall n : Nat, f(n) = add(a, mul(n, d)) := by
  intro initial
  intro step
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
      exact initial
  | succ k ih =>
      rewrite -> step k
      rewrite -> ih
      rewrite -> N.mul_succ_left
      rewrite <- N.add_assoc {n := d; m := a; k := mul(k, d)}
      rewrite -> N.add_comm {n := d; m := a}
      rewrite -> N.add_assoc
      refl

theorem ex21_4 (A : Type) (f g : Nat -> A) (step : Nat -> A -> A) :
  f(0) = g(0) ->
  (forall n : Nat, f(succ(n)) = step(n, f(n))) ->
  (forall n : Nat, g(succ(n)) = step(n, g(n))) ->
  forall n : Nat, f(n) = g(n) := by
  intro initial
  intro f_step
  intro g_step
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact initial
  | succ k ih =>
      rewrite -> f_step k
      rewrite -> g_step k
      rewrite -> ih
      refl

mode constructive

theorem ex22_1 (A : Type) (x : A) (xs : C.List A) :
  not C.length(C.cons(x, xs)) = 0 := by
  rewrite -> C.length_cons
  intro zero_length
  contradiction

theorem ex22_2(A : Type) (f g : A -> Nat) (xs : C.List A) :
  (forall x : A, C.Member(x, xs) -> add(f(x), g(x)) = 1) ->
  add(S.sum(C.map(f, xs)), S.sum(C.map(g, xs))) = C.length(xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro partition
      rewrite -> C.map_nil
      rewrite -> C.map_nil
      rewrite -> C.length_nil
      simp
      refl
  | cons x t ih =>
      intro partition
      have head_member : C.Member(x, C.cons(x, t)) := W.member_head
      have head : add(f(x), g(x)) = 1 := partition x head_member
      have on_tail : forall y : A, C.Member(y, t) -> add(f(y), g(y)) = 1 := by
        intro y
        intro member
        have in_list : C.Member(y, C.cons(x, t)) := W.member_tail {A := A; x := x; y := y; t := t} member
        exact partition y in_list
      have tail : add(S.sum(C.map(f, t)), S.sum(C.map(g, t))) = C.length(t) := ih on_tail
      rewrite -> C.map_cons
      rewrite -> C.map_cons
      rewrite -> S.sum_cons
      rewrite -> W.add_interchange
      rewrite -> head
      rewrite -> tail
      rewrite -> C.length_cons
      refl

theorem ex22_3 (A : Type) (f g h : A -> Nat) (xs : C.List A) (a b : Nat) :
  (forall x : A, C.Member(x, xs) -> h(x) = add(f(x), g(x))) ->
  S.sum(C.map(f, xs)) = a -> S.sum(C.map(g, xs)) = b ->
  S.sum(C.map(h, xs)) = add(a, b) := by
  intro pointwise
  intro first
  intro second
  have linear : S.sum(C.map(h, xs)) = add(S.sum(C.map(f, xs)), S.sum(C.map(g, xs))) := by
    exact P.numerator_add {A := A; f := f; g := g; h := h; xs := xs} pointwise
  rewrite -> first at linear
  rewrite -> second at linear
  exact linear

theorem ex22_4 (A : Type) (f : A -> Nat) (xs : C.List A) (k : Nat) :
  (forall x : A, C.Member(x, xs) -> f(x) = k) ->
  S.sum(C.map(f, xs)) = mul(C.length(xs), k) := by
  exact W.sum_map_constant_on {A := A; f := f; xs := xs; k := k}
